title: Elizondo on aliens storing messages in genetics
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Elizondo on aliens storing messages in genetics, about unspecified at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he said something really interesting if you were going to make something truly enduring truly enduring there's really only two ways to do it you either put something out and deep space where the chances are of it coming into contact with something or minimal or biology genetics

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, passes on something Lou Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who speaks publicly about UFOs, told him. According to Michels, Elizondo said that if you wanted to make something truly lasting, there are only two ways: send it into deep space, where it is unlikely to hit anything, or write it into biology and genetics. The point is that a non-human intelligence might have left a message inside living things.
